status: Current primary facts for patient/knowledge drafting; no application mutation or independent clinical approval

dactinomycin.jurisdiction: UK manufacturer SmPC; supplied Irish product requires pharmacy reconciliation
dactinomycin.mechanism: Binds DNA and disrupts DNA-dependent RNA synthesis.
risk_groups: Bone-marrow suppression, serious infection and bleeding
Mouth/gut ulceration, nausea, vomiting and bowel changes
Severe liver injury including hepatic blood-flow obstruction
Severe tissue damage after leakage outside the vein
Increased radiation effects and radiation recall
Severe skin reactions, allergy, later malignancy and reproductive harm
dactinomycin.monitoring: Frequent blood-count, liver and kidney assessment; close symptom review.
dactinomycin.reproductive: Effective contraception during and at least7months afterwards for women, at least4months for men; no breastfeeding. This is agent-specific, not the combined-regimen duration.

irish_link_status.inconsistency: HPRA page also displays Marketed; local supplied product/licensing must be verified.
irish_link_status.interpretation: Do not call the old2011 linked SmPC current Irish information; this does not establish withdrawal of the current NCCP regimen.

risk_groups: Marrow suppression, serious infection and bleeding
Low sodium and excess retained water
Secondary malignancy and liver blood-flow injury
Hair/mouth effects, impaired wound healing and potentially permanent infertility
cyclophosphamide.monitoring: Blood counts before each administration and regularly; urine and organ review.
cyclophosphamide.reproductive: Product states female6months/male3months after treatment; breastfeeding contraindicated. Reconcile all agents and supplied products.
cyclophosphamide.boundary: Product GFR<10mL/min recommends50%; NCCP IE/VAC uses different organ bands. Product-specific specialist reconciliation, no imported numeric prescription. Ewing is a listed indication; no blanket licence claim for every tumour.
cyclophosphamide.other_retrieval_limits: Endoxana500medicines.ie current page returned only shell; HPRA15728 unavailable. UK BaxterSmPC displayed2016 despite2026PIL. Current Irish Seacross is explicitly identified.
